subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------ACT.TR.
description: Diagram in (Level One) World Music section (WM-10), embedded in Braxton's argument that world creativity functions as 'a ritualization of the total understanding of its given culture group' rather than as standalone aesthetic product. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is crossed with ACT-TR (actual transformation), and the dashed edge from ACT-TR to RT-DY (reality dynamics) registers that transformation is only 'actual' when reality-dynamics-level potential gets activated — not assumed. T-C-IMP branches three ways: into AFL (affinity alignment) extending through EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) and a dashed link to INFO-DE-B (a diagram-only term, likely 'information documentation basis'); into PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) bearing on POL-CON (political consciousness) and (r)INTR (interpretation); and into PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). The argument: a culture's creative time-continuum implications only manifest as actual transformation when affinity alignment extends into dynamic continuance and physical-universe particulars connect to interpretive practice — the WM section's case for world creativity as essence-functional rather than spectacle-viewable.
